info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 遴選學生至業界實習，提前與職場接軌，旨在加強理論與實務的整合，以強化學生專業技能，提升就業競爭力。
description.describe_eh: The course is designed to offer students who are recommended a value-added opportunity to include work experience as part of their study. It aims to integrate the theory and practice in order to strengthen the professional skills and the competitiveness of students.

targets.describe_ch: 強化專業技能，提升理論與實務整合之能力。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen students’ professional skills and to integrate the theory and practice for students.

targets.describe_ch: 強化職場倫理、提升協調溝通與團隊合作之能力。
targets.describe_en: To engage in effective communication and strategies of teamwork.

textBooks.tpb_book_en: Self-compiled teaching materials (related to interview skills, pre and post-internship considerations, etc.)

Teacher's observations and evaluations, review and investigation
Contacting the company to confirm interview time

教師定時聯繫

成果發表或心得報告

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
校外實習之成績考評以通過與未完成為原則。(學期實習課必須配合實習單位全職參與)
研習時數，以80小時為一學分。本課程，共計9學分，應時習720小時（含座談及研習活動）。
實得學分數，將視研習時數而定。
評量依據：個人實習體驗成效評估表、企業實習體驗成效評估表，實習報告單、心得報告單。（導師評分40％，企業評估60％。）
預計2-3個月實習訪視、並安排座談及不定期會談。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
The evaluation of off-campus internships is based on a pass or incomplete basis. (Students must actively participate full-time in the internship program during the semester). The credit hours for this course are based on a total of 9 credits, with 80 hours of study equivalent to one credit. Therefore, a total of 720 hours of study (including seminars and research activities) are required for this course. The number of credits earned will depend on the number of study hours completed.
 
Assessment criteria include: Individual internship performance assessment, corporate internship performance assessment, internship report form, and reflective report. (Instructor's assessment accounts for 40%, and corporate assessment accounts for 60%).
Anticipated 2-3 months of internship visits will be conducted, along with scheduled seminars and periodic meetings.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 實習單位要求必須要遵守，並維護自身及校系該有之形象，呈現良好職場態度。但若有與合約不符之處，必須要即時告知實習指導老師。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
實習單位要求必須要遵守，並維護自身及校系該有之形象，呈現良好職場態度。但若有與合約不符之處，必須要即時告知實習指導老師。

You must adhere to the requirements set by the internship organization and uphold the appropriate image for both yourself and your academic department, demonstrating a positive workplace attitude. However, if there are any discrepancies with the contract, you must immediately inform the internship supervisor.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
實習前之簽約、實習當中與實習指導老師之聯繫，必須要完整。此外，在相關的實習紀錄部分要具體完成。
若實習間有任何狀況，要即時和主動與實習導師聯繫。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
實習前之簽約、實習當中與實習指導老師之聯繫，必須要完整。此外，在相關的實習紀錄部分要具體完成。 若實習間有任何狀況，要即時和主動與實習導師聯繫。
 
The signing of agreements before the internship and communication with the internship supervisor during the internship must be complete. Additionally, the relevant internship records must be completed in detail.
 
If there are any issues during the internship, you should promptly and proactively contact the internship supervisor.
